messages.en: Be careful eating that fish. It's got lots of bones.
Okay, I've already picked out the bones and put them at the edge of my plate.
I want to sign up too. Where do I write my name?
Just write your name here, then submit it.
That stall only takes cash, so make sure you bring some.
Okay, I'll get some cash from the ATM first.
Duck your head a little when you come in, okay? The doorway's low.
Okay, I'll duck. Good thing you told me!
